note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.2 and current gr.go/gr_state.go (post-18b491ae23). Section 4.2 requires deleting previously stale routes on consecutive restarts (conventional GR; RFC 9494 Section 4.2 overrides consecutive-restart deletion only for running LLGR families). For conventional GR (no preservedLLGR and no expiredDuringSync), onSessionDownPlan sets plan.purgeAllPrevious=true, deletes the prior peer entry, and rebuilds staleFamilies from the new capability; handleStructuredState dispatches purge-stale on plan.prevSource before retain-routes and mark-stale. All 4 tag bindings across 3 functions verified: TestGRConsecutiveRestartClearsPriorStale contrasts consecutive drop replacing a two-family stale set with one family against a fresh peer's first drop; TestRFC4724ConsecutiveRestartDeletesThePreviouslyStaleRoutes and TestRFC4724ConsecutiveRestartDeletesBeforeMarking drive a real RIB through two drops with only 198.51.101.0/24 refreshed in between, asserting unrefreshed 198.51.100.0/24 is deleted while refreshed 198.51.101.0/24 survives at stale-level 1. Scope note: the two real-RIB tests share helper rfc4724SecondRestart with distinct target prefixes for deletion vs preservation, unchanged from prior scope.
